company_goal.objective: Grow revenue from existing customers without raising renewal risk.
measures: Partner-sourced expansion revenue grows every quarter
Gross renewal rate stays at or above 90%

asking.objective: Start a partner investment program that grows partner-sourced revenue.
measures: Ten partners enrolled in the investment program by quarter end

owning.objective: Keep renewal and retention risk low across the customer base.
measures: No more than 5% of renewal revenue flagged at risk each quarter
Every at-risk renewal has an owner within one week

dependency: Partnerships needs Revenue Operations to fund the program and track partner-touched accounts in its renewal-risk model, and Revenue Operations decides which accounts partners may work on.

work_items.task: Shortlist the first ten partners for the investment program
Draft the program's funding tiers and partner terms
Quarterly renewal-risk review of the top 200 accounts

plan.title: Partner investment program, ten partners first
plan.text: Partnerships starts a partner investment program with ten partners: co-funded campaigns and a shared list of expansion accounts. Revenue Operations adds partner-touched accounts to its renewal-risk model and reviews them every month. Two requirements come with the program and are not settled yet. Legal: partners see only the customer data each account has agreed to share, and no raw usage data. Product: partners stay on current product features, with no partner-only roadmap commitments. In return, Partnerships pauses the program for any account whose renewal risk rises. Agreement between these two teams is not approval to launch: the program still needs launch approval from the executive team.
